        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"

        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"

    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"

<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-required"
            title="Required">
        <span id="name_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#name_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">

</h4>

<div>

<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Ports for http origin-pull requests. value range: 1-65535. this parameter takes effect only when the origin-pull protocol originprotocol is http or follow.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="httpsoriginport_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#httpsoriginport_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Https<wbr>Origin<wbr>Port</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Ports for https origin-pull requests. value range: 1-65535. this parameter takes effect only when the origin-pull protocol originprotocol is https or follow.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="origin_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#origin_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Origin</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Origin server address, which varies according to the value of origintype: When origintype = ipdomain, fill in an ipv4 address, an ipv6 address, or a domain name; When origintype = cos, please fill in the access domain name of the cos bucket; When origintype = awss3, fill in the access domain name of the s3 bucket; When origintype = origingroup, fill in the origin server group id; When origintype = loadbalance, fill in the cloud load balancer instance id. this feature is currently only available to the allowlist.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="originprotocol_csharp">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Origin-Pull protocol configuration. this parameter is required when origintype is ipdomain, origingroup, or loadbalance. valid values are: http: use http protocol; https: use https protocol; follow: follow the protocol.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="origintype_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#origintype_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Origin<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The origin type. values: IPDomain: ipv4, ipv6, or domain name type origin server; OriginGroup: origin server group type origin server; LoadBalance: cloud load balancer (clb), this feature is in beta test. to use it, please submit a ticket or contact smart customer service; COS: tencent cloud COS origin server; AWSS3: all object storage origin servers that support the aws s3 protocol.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="privateaccess_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#privateaccess_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Private<wbr>Access</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether access to the private object storage origin server is allowed. this parameter is valid only when the origin server type origintype is COS or awss3. valid values: on: enable private authentication; off: disable private authentication. if not specified, the default value is off.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="privateparameters_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#privateparameters_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Private<wbr>Parameters</a>

    </dt>
    <dd>Private authentication parameter. this parameter is valid only when origintype = awss3 and privateaccess = on.</dd></dl>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>

    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>

<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>

    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"

<div>
<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="hcl">
<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-required"
            title="Required">
        <span id="name_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#name_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>

    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"

<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-required"

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"

        <span class="property-type">str</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"

<div>
<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="yaml">
<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-required"
            title="Required">
        <span id="name_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#name_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="accessurlredirectparameters_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#accessurlredirectparameters_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">access<wbr>Url<wbr>Redirect<wbr>Parameters</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#l7accrulev2branchsubrulebranchsubrulebranchsubrulebranchsubrulebranchactionaccessurlredirectparameters">Property Map</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The access url redirection configuration parameter. this parameter is required when name is accessurlredirect.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="advancedoriginroutingparameters_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#advancedoriginroutingparameters_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">advanced<wbr>Origin<wbr>Routing<wbr>Parameters</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>

<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="httporiginport_csharp">

</span>

        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Origin failover type. Values: FailoverToHost: failover to specified IP/domain; FailoverToCOS: failover to Tencent Cloud COS; FailoverToS3CompatibleObjectStorage: failover to S3 compatible storage; FailoverRedirectToURL: redirect to specified URL; FailoverCustomResponsePage: use custom response page.</dd><dt class="property-optional"

    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">

<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-required"
            title="Required">
        <span id="name_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#name_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">

<div>
<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="javascript,typescript">
<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-required"
            title="Required">
        <span id="name_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#name_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="accessurlredirectparameters_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#accessurlredirectparameters_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">access<wbr>Url<wbr>Redirect<wbr>Parameters</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#l7accrulev2branchsubrulebranchsubrulebranchsubrulebranchsubrulebranchsubrulebranchactionaccessurlredirectparameters">L7Acc<wbr>Rule<wbr>V2Branch<wbr>Sub<wbr>Rule<wbr>Branch<wbr>Sub<wbr>Rule<wbr>Branch<wbr>Sub<wbr>Rule<wbr>Branch<wbr>Sub<wbr>Rule<wbr>Branch<wbr>Sub<wbr>Rule<wbr>Branch<wbr>Action<wbr>Access<wbr>Url<wbr>Redirect<wbr>Parameters</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The access url redirection configuration parameter. this parameter is required when name is accessurlredirect.</dd><dt class="property-optional"

    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"

<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-required"

<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#name_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"

</h4>

<div>

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Ports for http origin-pull requests. value range: 1-65535. this parameter takes effect only when the origin-pull protocol originprotocol is http or follow.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="httpsoriginport_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#httpsoriginport_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Https<wbr>Origin<wbr>Port</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Ports for https origin-pull requests. value range: 1-65535. this parameter takes effect only when the origin-pull protocol originprotocol is https or follow.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="origin_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#origin_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Origin</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Origin server address, which varies according to the value of origintype: When origintype = ipdomain, fill in an ipv4 address, an ipv6 address, or a domain name; When origintype = cos, please fill in the access domain name of the cos bucket; When origintype = awss3, fill in the access domain name of the s3 bucket; When origintype = origingroup, fill in the origin server group id; When origintype = loadbalance, fill in the cloud load balancer instance id. this feature is currently only available to the allowlist.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="originprotocol_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#originprotocol_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Origin<wbr>Protocol</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Origin-Pull protocol configuration. this parameter is required when origintype is ipdomain, origingroup, or loadbalance. valid values are: http: use http protocol; https: use https protocol; follow: follow the protocol.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="origintype_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#origintype_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Origin<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The origin type. values: IPDomain: ipv4, ipv6, or domain name type origin server; OriginGroup: origin server group type origin server; LoadBalance: cloud load balancer (clb), this feature is in beta test. to use it, please submit a ticket or contact smart customer service; COS: tencent cloud COS origin server; AWSS3: all object storage origin servers that support the aws s3 protocol.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="privateaccess_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#privateaccess_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Private<wbr>Access</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether access to the private object storage origin server is allowed. this parameter is valid only when the origin server type origintype is COS or awss3. valid values: on: enable private authentication; off: disable private authentication. if not specified, the default value is off.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="privateparameters_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#privateparameters_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Private<wbr>Parameters</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>

    </dt>
    <dd>Private authentication parameter. this parameter is valid only when origintype = awss3 and privateaccess = on.</dd></dl>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>

        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Origin failover type. Values: FailoverToHost: failover to specified IP/domain; FailoverToCOS: failover to Tencent Cloud COS; FailoverToS3CompatibleObjectStorage: failover to S3 compatible storage; FailoverRedirectToURL: redirect to specified URL; FailoverCustomResponsePage: use custom response page.</dd><dt class="property-optional"

    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>

<div>
<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="hcl">
<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-required"
            title="Required">
        <span id="name_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#name_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">

<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="java">
<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-required"
            title="Required">
        <span id="name_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#name_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">

<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-required"

<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#name_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"

    </dt>
    <dd>Operation name. The name needs to correspond to the parameter structure, for example, if Name=Cache, CacheParameters is required.</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Cache</code>: Node cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>CacheKey</code>: Custom Cache Key;</li>
<li><code>CachePrefresh</code>: Cache pre-refresh;</li>
<li><code>AccessURLRedirect</code>: Access URL redirection;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamURLRewrite</code>: Back-to-origin URL rewrite;</li>
<li><code>QUIC</code>: QUIC;</li>
<li><code>WebSocket</code>: WebSocket;</li>
<li><code>Authentication</code>: Token authentication;</li>
<li><code>MaxAge</code>: Browser cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>StatusCodeCache</code>: Status code cache TTL;</li>
<li><code>OfflineCache</code>: Offline cache;</li>
<li><code>SmartRouting</code>: Smart acceleration;</li>
<li><code>RangeOriginPull</code>: Segment back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamHTTP2</code>: HTTP2 back-to-origin;</li>
<li><code>HostHeader</code>: Host Header rewrite;</li>
<li><code>ForceRedirectHTTPS</code>: Access protocol forced HTTPS jump configuration;</li>
<li><code>OriginPullProtocol</code>: Back-to-origin HTTPS;</li>
<li><code>Compression</code>: Smart compression configuration;</li>
<li><code>HSTS</code>: HSTS;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPHeader</code>: Header information configuration for storing client request IP;</li>
<li><code>OCSPStapling</code>: OCSP stapling;</li>
<li><code>HTTP2</code>: HTTP2 Access;</li>
<li><code>PostMaxSize</code>: POST request upload file streaming maximum limit configuration;</li>
<li><code>ClientIPCountry</code>: Carry client IP region information when returning to the source;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamFollowRedirect</code>: Return to the source follow redirection parameter configuration;</li>
<li><code>UpstreamRequest</code>: Return to the source request parameters;</li>
<li><code>TLSConfig</code>: SSL/TLS security;</li>
<li><code>ModifyOrigin</code>: Modify the source station;</li>
<li><code>HTTPUpstreamTimeout</code>: Seven-layer return to the source timeout configuration;</li>
<li><code>HttpResponse</code>: HTTP response;</li>
<li><code>ErrorPage</code>: Custom error page;</li>
<li><code>ModifyResponseHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node response header;</li>
<li><code>ModifyRequestHeader</code>: Modify HTTP node request header;</li>
<li><code>ResponseSpeedLimit</code>: Single connection download speed limit.</li>
<li><code>SetContentIdentifier</code>: Set content identifier.</li>
<li><code>Vary</code>: Vary feature configuration.</li>
<li><code>ContentCompression</code>: Content compression configuration.</li>
<li><code>OriginAuthentication</code>: Origin authentication configuration.</li>
<li><code>AdvancedOriginRouting</code>: Advanced origin routing optimization.</li>
<li><code>Shield</code>: Origin offload (Shield).</li>
<li><code>SiteFailover</code>: Origin site failover.</li>
</ul></dd><dt class="property-optional"
